articles.summary: Sunrun wants to turn thousands of solar-powered homes into a giant distributed AI data center – and pay homeowners to help power the AI boom.

articles.title_original: Ford admits its $30K midsize EV pickup is actually ‘small’
articles.title_zh: 福特承认其3万美元中型电动皮卡实际上“很小”
articles.summary: Ford’s midsize EV pickup, due out next year, will be smaller than expected. For the first time, Ford referred to it as an “all-new, affordable small electric pickup” built on the UEV platform.

articles.title_original: China is bringing buttons back to cars, ending trend led by Tesla
articles.title_zh: 中国让汽车按键回归，终结特斯拉引领的潮流
articles.summary: China will require automakers to include physical buttons for safety-related functions, pushing back on the proliferation of using screens for everything in modern cars.
